hints.title: Digit Position Recurrence
hints.text: Count qualifying numbers up to an upper limit by fixing digits from highest to lowest significance.

hints.title: Non-decreasing Transition Constraint
hints.text: Every placed digit must be greater than or equal to the preceding digit once leading zeros conclude.

hints.title: Range Count Subtraction
hints.text: Compute total valid numbers below r and subtract valid numbers below l, taking differences modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: D: number of digits in base b representation
complexity.notes: Digit states track current position, previous digit value, tight bound, and leading zero flag.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating over large numeric intervals exceeds execution time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoized states eliminate recomputation across digit prefixes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use digit DP to handle leading zeros and prefix equality bounds.
